The case against is stronger. Net flow over the last 15 minutes is -5.65 SOL, sellers outpaced buyers in SOL terms, and the sell-to-buy ratio in the launch window was 1.33. The coin is down 14% in the last 15 minutes and 26% off its high, which is the pattern of a fading pump. Class is UNRESOLVED, the curve data is missing, and the name and symbol are null, so there is no visible story or operator signal. A launch bot was present.

My verdict: no strong case to buy now. Demand is broad but net-selling and falling. Skip unless a later read shows net inflow returning.
memos.skeptic: Most likely loss path: insider distribution into a weak bid. The first two minutes show sell-to-buy of 1.33 (more SOL sold than bought at launch) and a launch bot present, so early supply has been moving out. The last 15 minutes are net negative (-5.65 SOL net flow, sells 49.94 vs buys 44.29, return -14.3%), and the coin is already 26% off its 30-minute high despite a +10.4% 30-minute return, so the move has rolled over. With a 84 SOL pool, a $20 round trip faces roughly 1.4-5.1% in fees and impact, and a small bounce can't clear that. Buyer count (77) and volume ($11.4k) look active but don't offset the sell pressure. Curve bundle and top-3 data are null, so insider concentration can't be ruled out. Name and symbol are null too. Skip.
